# MarkDev

> MarkDev is a premium, remote-first global digital agency that designs, builds, and grows high-performance websites, Shopify stores, custom web & Flutter apps, and full-funnel marketing (SEO, Google & Meta Ads, social, and conversion rate optimization). Positioning: Awwwards-grade craft fused with a measurable conversion and SEO engine. Tagline: Learn · Build · Grow.

## Services

### Build
- [Full-Stack Web Development](https://markdev.agency/services/web-development): Fast, SEO-first websites and platforms in Next.js, React & TypeScript.
- [Shopify & Shopify Plus Development](https://markdev.agency/services/shopify-development): Custom and headless (Hydrogen) commerce that converts.
- [Custom Web Application Development](https://markdev.agency/services/web-applications): SaaS products, dashboards, and internal tools built to scale.
- [Flutter App Development](https://markdev.agency/services/flutter-app-development): iOS & Android apps from a single codebase.
- [Website Maintenance](https://markdev.agency/services/website-maintenance): Proactive care plans — monitoring, security, and improvements.
- [Performance Optimization](https://markdev.agency/services/performance-optimization): Core Web Vitals and speed engineering.

### Grow
- [Digital Marketing](https://markdev.agency/services/digital-marketing): Full-funnel growth tied to revenue.
- [SEO](https://markdev.agency/services/seo): Technical, content, and authority SEO that compounds.
- [Google Ads](https://markdev.agency/services/google-ads): Profitable paid search, shopping, and Performance Max.
- [Meta Ads](https://markdev.agency/services/meta-ads): Facebook & Instagram advertising that scales.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://markdev.agency/services/social-media-marketing): Content, community, and growth.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization](https://markdev.agency/services/conversion-rate-optimization): A/B testing and UX that lifts revenue.

### Design
- [UI/UX Design](https://markdev.agency/services/ui-ux-design): Research-led product and web design.
- [Branding](https://markdev.agency/services/branding): Strategy-led identity that commands trust.
- [Graphic Design](https://markdev.agency/services/graphic-design): On-brand creative for every channel.
